scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
